_about: Public-domain Augustin Poulain (1836-1919, Jesuit) in English for the Word Hoard: The Graces of Interior Prayer, a Treatise on Mystical Theology, tr. Leonora L. Yorke Smith from the sixth edition (London: Kegan Paul, 1910), from an Internet Archive scan. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 32 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
